first.subject: I built a website for Beauty In A Box Co
first.body:
Hi there,

I'm Bailey Bright from One Sight Studio in Brisbane. I came across Beauty In A Box Co on Fresha and put together a website for you. It's already built. Have a look:

https://onesightstudio.au/beauty-in-a-box-co/

If you like it, it can be live on your own domain this week, for $29 a month. No setup fee, no lock-in, and changes are included. Want something changed first? There's a "Request changes" button at the top of the preview.

We'd connect it to your existing domain, beautyinaboxcocaloundra.com.

Once it's live, we can also add it to your Google Business Profile so it shows when people search for you on Google and Maps.

If it's not for you, no worries. The preview comes down in 14 days.

Bailey Bright
One Sight Studio · ABN 88 359 529 731 · 0431 864 979 · hello@onesightstudio.au
